newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgacom signs understanding with China Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Belgacom signs understanding with China Telecom.

text.p: Belgium's partially privatised telecommunications operator Belgacom said on Monday it had signed a wide-ranging Memorandum of Understanding with China Telecom, China's national telecommunications operator.
The accord was signed during a Belgian trade mission to China led by Prince Philippe and Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt.

"This MOU will enable us to strengthen the existing links between China and Belgium," Belgacom said in a statement released in Brussels. It added that this would cover a broad spectrum from marketing to technology and management.
"Eventually, the Memorandum of Understanding could lead to the identification of more specific projects yet to be specified," the statement said.
It added that the two had already decided to reroute some of the telecommunications traffic between China and Belgium via an undersea fibre optic cable.
